data.body: Patch set 2 pushed (commit 78c9cce398, same Change-Id). LLM-Review had voted +1 on PS1 with two ADVISORY (non-blocking, already-unresolved=0) test-coverage findings against my own new code, both of which named a real gap, so I addressed them rather than landing over them: (1) _config_globs' documented fail-open-on-ConfigError path had no test; (2) project_applies_to_globs' empty-config-override fallback (config key set but resolving to []) had no test. Added three offline tests — empty override falls back to the declared globs, a malformed [code_review] ci_config_globs value fails open AND logs 'unreadable', and a pointer naming a nonexistent <section>.<key> fails open AND logs 'names no config key'. Each asserts a log line only its own branch emits, so the branch is genuinely exercised. 18 tests in the file, lint + typecheck green. The PS1 LLM-Review+1 was auto-removed as outdated; both gates now re-run on PS2.
